review: Peer option forwarding keeps native settings and output schema without inventing a dynamic handler. Delete false preserves callbacks; actual cancel releases them. Source translation preserves per-actor queue identity, while capacity coordination uses a thread-specific identity. Pairing grants exact bot/chat/actor and device confirmation. Original-source guards, durable write receipts, restart exemption after persisted acceptance, and no replay of accepted or unknown input are asserted. Closing an account facade does not close the shared device or stop work. Recovery maps persistent peer IDs to the original exact source, rejects unauthorized, ambiguous and partial history, and performs read-only acceptance repair. Interaction fixture registration begins in the last file.
